Frequently asked questions

All FAQs Contact us
How does a facility request staff?

Use the request form to tell us the roles, headcount and timing, or call us. A staffing specialist replies within one business day.

How quickly will we see candidates?

It depends on the role and the location, but you can usually expect credentialed candidates to review within days of a request.

What do you verify before a clinician starts?

Licenses and certifications at the source, health records, background checks and references, to your standards and those of your accrediting body.

Which types of cover do you offer?

Travel contracts, local contracts, per diem cover and permanent placement, all under one agreement.

Do you offer programs beyond single placements?

Yes: contract therapy, credentialing and compliance, a rural and critical access program, managed staffing programs and surge response.

Who is Mutex Healthcare Staffing?

We are a healthcare staffing agency. Our name says how we work: one opening, one right clinician, one recruiter accountable for the match.

What kinds of jobs do you fill?

Travel contracts, local contracts, per diem shifts and permanent positions. Most assignments run 8 to 26 weeks, across hospitals, skilled nursing, home health, outpatient clinics, schools and government settings.

Do you show pay on every job?

Yes. Every posting shows the hourly rate and an estimated weekly gross, or the salary for permanent roles. Your recruiter walks you through the full package before you accept anything.

How do I apply?

Find a job you like, tap Apply and fill in a two-minute form. A recruiter reaches out within one business day to talk through the role, your credentials and your start date.

How does credentialing work?

We verify licenses and certifications at the source, collect health and background requirements, and track every expiry date for the length of the assignment. You get one checklist and one person to send things to.

I have never taken a travel assignment. Can I still work with you?

Absolutely. Your recruiter will explain how contracts, housing and licensing work, and will point you to first-timer-friendly facilities. Most roles ask for one to two years of recent experience in your specialty.

Does it cost anything to work with you?

No. There is never a fee to a clinician, for contract work or for permanent placement.
